column1: #  - a top-level equation is a function, once however many equations it has; the type signature is not a definition of its own, and a point-free value (total = sum <<< map area) is a function too;
#  - foreign import names a function; foreign import data names a class;

#  - data and newtype are classes; type synonyms are type aliases; class is an interface and the signatures in its body are methods; the fields of a record newtype and of a record type synonym are fields;
#  - instance bodies, derive declarations, where/let bindings, data constructors and fixity declarations (infixl 6 addPoints as |+|) are not definitions.
